description: Brazilian NF-e/NFC-e XML-to-JSON compressor (~90% token savings), mathematical & CFOP tax auditor, and 44-digit Access Key Mod-11 decoder (0.01 USDC via x402 on Base).

accessKey.description: Optional 44-digit Brazilian NF-e access key (Chave de Acesso) to decompose UF, issue date, issuer CNPJ, model, number, and validate Mod-11 check digit.

aiSummary.description: Generate a concise accounting/tax audit summary via Cloudflare Workers AI (default: true).

includeItems.description: Include line-item details (NCM, CFOP, quantities, ICMS/IPI/PIS/COFINS) in output (default: true).

xml.description: Raw Brazilian NF-e or NFC-e XML content (<nfeProc> or <NFe>, SEFAZ 4.00 layout) to parse, compress (~90% token savings), and mathematically audit.

name: br_nfe_xml_auditor
